description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Filter, which implements validation logic for a proprietary CSS filter related to Microsoft's Alpha filter, specifically handling the 'alpha' filter functions within the HTMLPurifier project.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Filter
classes.description: A class responsible for validating proprietary CSS filter functions, supporting the 'alpha' filter with specific handling for opacity levels and filter syntax.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Filter class by creating an instance of the integer validator used for opacity values.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CSS filter string, ensuring it is a supported 'alpha' filter, extracts parameters, validates opacity values, and reconstructs the filter function string if valid.
